At alpha=0 it squares exactly; for fixed 0<alpha<1, u_n<=max(alpha,1-alpha) and the product (s_{n+1}/(r s_n)) has summable deviations and strictly positive finite limit. With r_N=cq^{2^{N-1}}, log(s_N/s_1^{2^{N-1}}) is squeezed by r_N 2^{N-1}/s_1^{2^{N-2}} ->0 (q=a0a2<1/4). Since s_1=q+O(r_N), s_N/r_N->1/c; recurrence then gives (1+c)/c² at offset 1 and all fixed higher offsets by induction. Independently rederived exact scalar recurrence and iterated original map at 100-digit precision with c=1.7 and N=4,5,6, matching limits.
